svg.aria-label: A Hyprland desktop under a floating waybar of frosted pills: workspaces with a glyph per open window, the window title, Tannoy's cover and song, a pill of lamps, the audio pill, the desk pill and the Timetable clock. A build turns the Roundhouse lamp red; its drawer says memory is stalling, and its link opens the Switchyard board, where android is held until storefront finishes, the lamp calms and android starts. The Tannoy player slides out of the cover, and picking Chrome swaps the bar to a podcast. An agent asks for a secret: broker's request window waits for a YubiKey touch while the Signal Box lamp turns to an amber key, then the Signal Box panel lists every live grant and Revoke all dims the lamp. The volume switches to the headset and the mouse battery runs low. Logbook's lamp turns frost when Chrome takes the mic; its drawer records the meeting on air, with do not disturb hiding the song, marks a moment, and stops, and the transcript is made and ready to copy; dictation types a comment into the editor. The desk drawer slides the key lights and the power menu out of its arrow, and the key lights warm the room. The Timetable clock names the next meeting, its drawer starts a focus block, then the clock turns amber and red to join. The Tablet lamp starts the work VPN, pulses amber through the web sign-in and turns frost; its drawer shows the tunnel held with both probes answering, then stale when nothing gets through, and Reconnect brings it back. A swaync notification arrives, and do not disturb silences it and hides the song.

click it to see why: memory is stalling

now playing, and the player slides out of the cover

an agent asks for a secret; broker asks you
a YubiKey touch grants it for an hour
every secret agents can use right now, and for how long

click to switch to the headset
frost: Chrome has the mic, and Logbook says so
Record meeting: on air, and do not disturb hides the song
Mark the moment to come back to
Stop: the transcript makes itself, one Switchyard task
middle-click the lamp and talk; voxtype types where the cursor is
the key lights and the power menu wait behind the arrow
both Elgato lights in one click; lit, the lamp stays in view
the clock names the next meeting
three zones, Join, and the day with its free gaps
a focus block that ends before the next meeting
red at start time; middle-click joins on workspace 2

amber while the web sign-in waits
probes check that the tunnel really works
connected, but nothing gets through: stale
